title: Pause, change encryption and recover both devices
description: One saved developer uses two authenticated devices to migrate a waiting campaign from inspectable encryption to actual Cloud KMS and back. Ordinary UI creates and joins the fixed-catalogue campaign. No state, migration result or provider is injected. This is two-device recovery for one recipient, not complete multi-recipient, hosted authentication or worker-fault certification.

steps.description: Save a developer identity and create and join a waiting mock campaign through the ordinary UI; only developer authorization and catalogue entropy are test-controlled.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Sign into the same invitation on a second device and review the current encryption on both.
steps.acknowledgement: Both devices recover the current mock mode and available pause control.
verifications: Read-only canonical metadata confirms mock epoch 1, revision 2, with no extra mutation on recovery.
Both devices retain campaign access without alerts; prior mock exposure remains explicit.

steps.description: Pause the campaign before migrating to real encryption.
steps.acknowledgement: The pause command is acknowledged and the connected device offers resume.
verifications: Read-only canonical metadata confirms mock epoch 1, revision 3, with no extra mutation on recovery.
Both devices retain campaign access without alerts; prior mock exposure remains explicit.

steps.description: Select real encryption without committing the change.
steps.acknowledgement: The proposed mode enables the explicit migration commitment.
verifications: Read-only canonical metadata confirms mock epoch 1, revision 3, with no extra mutation on recovery.
An uncommitted choice does not alter the second device’s authoritative mode.
Both devices retain campaign access without alerts; prior mock exposure remains explicit.

steps.description: Commit real migration, observe focused progress, then wait for verified activation and resumed access.
steps.acknowledgement: The service reports verified completion, restores chart focus and updates the connected device.
verifications: Read-only canonical metadata confirms real epoch 2, revision 4, with no extra mutation on recovery.
Both devices remain free of alerts after authoritative activation.

steps.description: Reload the exact campaign and review recovered real encryption with its permanent exposure warning.
steps.acknowledgement: The recovered campaign retains the activated mode and allows normal pause controls.
verifications: Read-only canonical metadata confirms real epoch 2, revision 4, with no extra mutation on recovery.
Both devices retain campaign access without alerts; prior mock exposure remains explicit.
Reload keeps the exact campaign invitation.
